BAIL APPLN. 959/2023 & BAIL APPLN. 960/2023 These are the applications seeking anticipatory bail in FIR No. 55/2023 dated 27.01.2023 u/s 498A/304B/34 IPC registered at PS Punjabi Bagh.
As per the FIR, the daughter of the complainant, Chhaya committed suicide by hanging herself.
The present applications have been filed by the brother-in-law (jija) and the cousin brother of the husband of the deceased victim.
As per the FIR, the allegations against the applicants are prima facie cryptic and do not allege any instance of cruelty and do not show demand of dowry by the applicants.

The allegations are as under:
"I blame Rahul (husband), Vikram, Sahil, Ravi, Mamta and Abhilasha for Chhaya's Ravi vs The State (Nct Of Delhi) on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/19994156/
1 death and want action to be taken against all of them."
